sentences.text: The Amazon rainforest is home to millions of fascinating species.
Howler monkeys and bright parrots move constantly through the leafy green canopy.
Down on the dark, damp forest floor, tiny leaf-cutter ants march in long lines.
Nearby, a slow-moving sloth rests high above, completely hidden by hanging vines and thick moss.
Researchers must study the ecosystem carefully to spot all these camouflaged creatures.

challenges.correctMeaning: Hidden by blending into the surrounding environment
meaningOptions: Hidden by blending into the surrounding environment
Sleeping high up in the trees
Moving very slowly through the vines
challenges.dictionaryDefinition: Disguised or hidden by blending in with the surrounding background or environment.

sentences.text: Life in the tropical rainforest is full of daily challenges for its animal residents.
Jaguar cubs watch their mothers hunt for prey during the warm afternoon hours.
During heavy tropical storms, rain pours down continuously for hours, soaking everything in sight.
Small frogs hop quickly under broad fern leaves to stay dry from the falling water.
Tree frogs must endure the freezing cold and wet conditions until the bright sun finally returns.

challenges.correctMeaning: To suffer through or put up with something difficult
meaningOptions: To suffer through or put up with something difficult
To run away very fast from danger
To find food during a heavy storm
To climb up the tallest trees
challenges.dictionaryDefinition: To remain firm under suffering or misfortune without giving way.

sentences.text: Exploring the dense rainforest requires patience and sharp observational skills.
A harpy eagle sits silently on a high branch, scanning the vast green landscape below.
Colorful poison dart frogs hop across the wet moss near a babbling stream.
Suddenly, a bright blue morpho butterfly flutters its wings in a patch of sunlight.
Biologists notice every tiny movement and sound echoing through the thick jungle.

challenges.correctMeaning: Looking closely across an area to search for something
meaningOptions: Looking closely across an area to search for something
Building a nest high in the trees
Making a loud noise to warn others
challenges.dictionaryDefinition: To look at something carefully or examine an area broadly.
